answer: For jobs such as a sonnet commission or detecting hollow timber, pay for completed tasks rather than account count. Validators accept one verified result per public task ID and mark it spent; aliases cannot claim the same task twice. Fund each task from the customer's payment, with no per-key signup subsidy. A farm must do additional useful work for each extra payout, consuming effort or compute even in parallel. This assumes honest task verification and solvent customer escrow; unverifiable work and colluding reviewers remain weaknesses.
